blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine women’s football team boosted its chances of reaching the quarterfinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 after defeating Hong Kong, 2-0, on Thursday at Gifu Nagaragawa Stadium. Skye Leach scored her first international goal early in the first half before Mallie Ramirez doubled the lead past the hour mark as the Filipinas secured the maximum three points after salvaging a 1-1 draw against Uzbekistan in the opener. Coach Mark Torcaso’s side climbed into second spot in Group G after equaling China with four points after two matches. China was earlier held to a 1-1 draw by Uzbekistan, which […]...
